overall_notes: The paper focuses on story author-style transfer, a specialized NLG task. The extraction was generally accurate but contained some redundancy and inconsistent naming. Paper uses standard automatic metrics (BLEU, BERTScore) and conducts thorough human evaluation with clear criteria. No LLM-based evaluation is used.
